findings.message: 3 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "SOFTWARE ENGINEER · FRONT-END" above "Do detalhe visual à arquitetura."; "Open source · em desenvolvimento" above "KOReader Ecosystem"; "Código aberto · Em desenvolvimento" above "Black Market"; "05" above "Prazer, Enzo."; "Aberto a conversar sobre oportunidades." above "Vamos construir o próximo capítulo?"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "01 / FRONT-END ENGINEERING", "EB.", "interface.tsx", "↗"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01 / FRONT-END ENGINEERING", "01", "01", "02", "01", "01 /"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 36 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "SOFTWARE ENGINEER · FRONT-END", "01 / FRONT-END ENGINEERING", "EB.", "DESIGN → CODE → PRODUCTION").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✳
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 3 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.engineering-visual.index-hero-visual → rgb(192, 184, 168) 10px 10px 0px 0px | div.system-window.index-parallax-layer → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.267) 0px 24px 70px 0px | div.code-fragment.index-parallax-layer → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.333) 0px 16px 45px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 32 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 1440px | div.window-bar 491px | div.ui-chart 389px | div.window-footer 490px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 12 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: Cream + terracotta palette (text #eeeae1, text #d2ad98, text #c47d5c, text #e2a184).
findings.fix: Re-draw the palette from the library. This pairing reads as an assistant brand, not yours.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (DM Sans, ui-monospace, DM Serif Display).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (2 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 89 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 85 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.

findings.message: 5 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Produtos em construção. Problemas do mundo real." → 4 lines (7 words, 40px); "Ferramentas pequenas. Problemas concretos." → 4 lines (4 words, 40px); "Uma boa interface começa antes do CSS." → 3 lines (7 words, 40px); "Gosto de conectar o que as pessoas veem ao que f" → 3 lines (14 words, 26px, a paragraph set above 24px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
